Hymn 223: opening-system investigation

2026-10-03 · Hymns (1985), 223 — Have I Done Any Good?
Stable ID: song-138d4697-d2d9-414a-885c-82b760f1f371

Finding and scope

Reproduced a grossly inflated pickup in Melody on desktop and both phone widths. It is not a source line/page break. OSMD 2.1.2's lyric expansion divides by a near-zero remaining rhythmic width. The source contains a legitimate two-sixteenth-note pickup, not a separate musical section.

Desktop Full did not reproduce the reported orphan in these runs. Some narrow phone Full cases still put the pickup alone because the following measure does not fit the selected scale plus the engine's reserved measure margin. This is distinct from Melody's erroneous width inflation. No phone selection or page-packing policy was changed. The supplied physical desktop report independently confirms a normal first system (indices 0–2), two pages, and 892.81/923.71px page-1 usage at 822px score width, scale .738/original. That reconciles the desktop Full case. Physical iPhone confirmation remains necessary; simulation is not physical-device proof.

Source and working-copy audit

Both parts start with measures 0, X1, X2, X3, all implicit, widths 191/210/210/235. Divisions=4; meter=6/8. Pickup duration=2 divisions (two sixteenths), followed by 12-division measures. Opening P1 print metadata has top-system-distance 127; P2 has staff-distance 143. Neither part requests new-system or new-page in these four measures. X2 in P2 contains a backup of 12 and voice-2 forwards 4/4/2, correctly retaining the same measure duration.

Opening directions are “Brightly,” dotted-quarter 46–58 with sound tempo 87, and the source corner glyph ⌜. None has a direction offset. The lyric verses begin “1. Have / I” and “2. There / are.” No detached lyric text causes the break. Opening metadata promotion leaves notes, timing and the corner mark intact.

Generated-harmony XML, zero-shift Transpose XML, projected Melody XML and engraving XML retain the same absence of opening source breaks. Harmony adds no print/layout break. All four working XML strings are byte-identical before/after the fix for every tested view/key: the patch changes only screen engraving measurements.

Width calculation and OSMD state

Melody's unexpanded rhythmic width is 2.348755 units. The first lyric anchor is x=2.300912; remaining width is only 0.047843. The second verse label width is 6.626953 with allowed overlap 3.4. Dividing its required remainder by 0.047843 yields an expansion factor around 67.45 and a false minimum width of 158.420217 units. The opening's measured note/verse footprint with clearance is about 12 units. The original Full profile caps lyric expansion at 2.5, so it does not exhibit this same enormous width in these tests.

Initial source flags and new-system/new-page rules are false. On the chosen desktop Melody render, existing tail balancing can subsequently set printNewSystemXml on source index 1 and enable the XML-system rule: that records the already-existing orphan after automatic wrapping, rather than causing it. After correction the opening no longer requires that temporary break. No source flags or structural semantics are edited by the new module.

Generalized screen-only correction

The shared screen engraver opts into a guarded width correction. It applies only to the first, genuinely short measure with lyrics when OSMD's inferred width exceeds four complete measured content footprints. It measures all verse/chord lanes, note positions and clearances, then uses that bounded footprint. Ordinary widths, later measures and complete opening measures are untouched. Explicit section/repeat/page breaks remain engine-owned. The print engraver never opts in; source/working/export XML is untouched.

No notation shrinking, source-break suppression, source edit, harmony change, Melody extraction change or phone pagination adjustment is included. Service-worker shell v211 includes the new local module; score-cache behavior is unchanged.

Residual phone Full case

WebKit 390 original key, zoom .56/moderate: first-system width 61.8743 units. Pickup minimum including instructions/end=17.3111; next measure in continuation position≈43.9468; the engine also reserves MeasureLeftMargin (.7). Sum≈61.9579, just greater than 61.8743. At +2, the pair needs still more width. No artificial source break is involved. This task leaves that existing fitting choice unchanged; it should not be presented as a complete resolution of the reported physical Full issue.

Continuous and Page Turns

Both modes use the same corrected engraving. Chromium desktop Melody drops from seven systems to six and continuous height 1095→960px, with one virtual page unchanged. Phone Melody's pickup joins index 1, but later line distribution leaves 13 systems and two pages; continuous height changes by only a few pixels. Full is exactly unchanged. No page-count target was forced.

Controls and musical preservation

202, 35, 68 and 204: exact before/after chosen system geometry, scale and page groups in Full and Melody at desktop. Hymn 202's genuine pickup is retained. Unit checks protect explicit system/page flags, print isolation, complete/later measures, ordinary widths, every lyric verse and chord spacing. Source MXL, Original PDF and generated harmony data match their pre-change Git blobs. All tested working XML is identical before/after, including notes, lyrics, harmony and durations.

Existing tight later lyric combinations such as “help was I” / “work will be known” remain in the baseline and corrected desktop Melody; this focused opening-width correction does not claim to fix those unrelated engraving details.

Visual evidence

Before (left) / after (right), desktop Melody and 390px Melody. Full screenshots and all diagnostic measurements are retained in local test-results.

Tests and files

  • tests/screen-pickup-layout.mjs — outlier guard, measured lanes, preserved flags/timing, print isolation.
  • tests/screen-pickup-render.mjs — 17 Chromium cases before/after and six WebKit cases before/after; Full original/+2 and Melody original; phone/desktop, Continuous/Page Turns.
  • tests/screen-pickup-results.mjs — exact comparison of working XML and controls, corrected opening without scale reduction.
  • tests/phone-full-layout.mjs — prior lyric-edge correction retained.
  • git diff --check.

Files: app.js, screen-pickup-layout.js, sw.js, the three new screen-pickup test files, and reports/223-opening-system.html/json. No vendor/source asset changes.

Commit and deployment outcome are reported in the accompanying chat summary. Physical-device confirmation remains outstanding; the received desktop device report confirms its Full layout is working; a remaining iPhone Full issue should be investigated separately using device measurements.
